scope: the .ifs concatenation hypothesis is DISPROVEN (mathematically impossible); the 41,648,405-byte mp_cross_fire.ff is a repatched 2.6.9.7 (ver 365) binary; swapping in the true 461 fastfile breaks startup unless the whole set is swapped
corrections_to_earlier_beliefs: WRONG: a usable .ff is ff_* + lf_* + lf_hi_* concatenated. A legal fastfile length is always 0x115 + N*0x2000 (277 + N*8192). Concatenating k members gives size mod 0x2000 = (277k) mod 8192, which equals 277 only for k=1 because 277 and 8192 are coprime. So no concatenation of 2..8192 members can ever be a legal fastfile.
WRONG: the 4.28 MB gap meant missing packages. It is a VERSION gap.

.ifs is a container: nifs header (172 B) + CRLF name list + 16-byte MD5 of the list + several COMPLETE signed fastfiles stored back to back. lf_* and lf_hi_* contain ZERO IWff occurrences - they are loose-asset packages and never participate in ff construction.

the_provenance_finding.what_it_actually_is: a 2.6.9.7 fastfile (version word 365) with exactly ONE byte patched at 0x8 (0x6D -> 0xCD) so it claims version 461
evidence: CODOL-2.6.9.7-Launcher/runtime/game/server2697/runtime-assets/chinese/mp_cross_fire.ff is 41,648,405, ver 365, sha 19f5b16f..., differing from the overlay copy at 0x8 only
the true 461 extraction from ff_init_mp_cross_fire_V70.ifs is 37,331,221 bytes (0x115 + 4557*0x2000), signature/hash-chain/zlib all pass, zone 75,189,466, 240 assets
the_provenance_finding.implication: the whole overlay is a 2.6.9.7 (365) resource set masquerading as 461. That is why the client accepts it at all, and it is a plausible reason a map can never finish loading.
